Minister Rijiju Condemns Racial Abuse of Tripura Youth by Delhi Influencer

Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has condemned a Delhi-based influencer for racially abusing a young man from Tripura, stating there is "no place for hate" and promising a "hard lesson" for the perpetrator. The incident, captured on video, has led to widespread condemnation, with Rijiju describing the influencer's actions as "evil".
